DRAFT – requires salesperson approval – availability unconfirmed
Not sendable as an offer

Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. As specified, we can't meet this request. The tool treats it as 30 people in one group, and our largest room, the Loft, holds a maximum of 24. The Studio holds a maximum of 12. Your plan of two sessions of 15 means two separate bookings, and we haven't priced that setup. We also haven't checked whether it would work, so nothing in this email is held for you.

There is one alternative. You would have to agree to it, and it means giving something up:



| Option | Package | People | Total | What the client gives up |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Loft + Coffee break | 24 | €612 | headcount reduced from 30 to at most 24 |

Every option changes a stated requirement and needs the client's explicit consent.



- This option is the Loft with a coffee break for every attendee. It reduces the headcount from 30 to at most 24.
- The prices shown cover ONE booking only. If you go ahead with two sessions, the other booking still has to be priced separately.
- We assumed the standard 4-hour block for each session, because you didn't give a duration. We only offer 4-hour bookings.
- Availability for your date has to be checked separately. We can't say that the same day is possible.
- The listed prices are fixed.

If you tell us how long each session needs to be, and whether a smaller group would work for you, I can look at this again.

Kind regards

grade.reason: The reply says 30 people exceeds the Loft's 24-person limit, so the request can't be met as specified. It flags the two-session split as unpriced and unchecked, and marks the draft as needing salesperson approval. The €612 alternative is arithmetically correct (420 + 24×8). It is labelled as covering one booking only, so it is not presented as the price of the whole event. Availability is not confirmed and no discount is offered.
